first_death_attack.title: Stop dying first on attack
first_death_attack.silverWording: You peeked first and alone. Wait for utility or a teammate swinging with you.
first_death_attack.immortalWording: Your contact is ahead of the pack. Delay and play second contact, or the pack has to be on your hip.
first_death_attack.drillSetup: For the next 5 ranked attack rounds on your main map: do not take the first peek unless a flash or recon is already used, or a teammate swings with you.
first_death_attack.successMetric: First-death-on-attack rate drops below 20% over the next 8 attack rounds.

untraded_entry.title: Stop taking untraded space
untraded_entry.silverWording: If you swing a corner, a teammate should be ready to shoot the same angle.
untraded_entry.immortalWording: Your entry timing is creating numbers-down rounds. Space is only worth it if the trade window is real.
untraded_entry.drillSetup: Call the swing before you take it. If nobody is with you, you do not go.
untraded_entry.successMetric: Untraded entry deaths drop over the next 8 games.

util_unused_on_death.title: Spend utility before the peek
util_unused_on_death.silverWording: If you bought a flash or recon, use it before you swing.
util_unused_on_death.immortalWording: Utility is late. The info or flash has to exist before first contact, not after you are already dead.
util_unused_on_death.drillSetup: Every gunfight in the next 3 games starts with a piece of utility, not a dry peek.
util_unused_on_death.successMetric: Utility rating is no longer the lowest scorecard item.

postplant_overpeek.title: Play the planted spike, not the extra fight
postplant_overpeek.silverWording: After the plant, hold an angle. Do not re-peek for style kills.
postplant_overpeek.immortalWording: Post-plant peeks are donating time. Play the clock and the off-angle.
postplant_overpeek.drillSetup: Next 5 post-plants: you hold, you do not wide-swing unless you hear the defuse.
postplant_overpeek.successMetric: Fewer deaths in the 10 seconds after a plant.

wrong_force_buy.title: Stop force-buying the wrong rounds
wrong_force_buy.silverWording: If the team cannot buy together, save. A half-buy that loses puts you behind two rounds.
wrong_force_buy.immortalWording: Your force rounds are not creating a numbers or spike advantage. Save unless the force has a plan.
wrong_force_buy.drillSetup: Look at team money before you click buy. If two teammates are saving, you save.
wrong_force_buy.successMetric: Econ rating is average or better over the next 5 games.

rifle_hs_below_band.title: Get rifle shots back to head height
rifle_hs_below_band.silverWording: Keep the crosshair at head height when you walk corners.
rifle_hs_below_band.immortalWording: HS% is below your band. This is a hygiene leak, not a new agent problem.
rifle_hs_below_band.drillSetup: 10 minutes of range bots or deathmatch with one rule: crosshair starts at head height before every swing.
rifle_hs_below_band.successMetric: HS% moves up toward your rank band over the next 8 games.
